prefs.memoryBlurb: Couple (25/25, ~160 lb woman + ~230 lb man). Love potatoes, steak, chicken, pasta. She nails fresh tomato pasta and chicken tikka masala; also solid at burgers, sloppy joes, frozen-veg sides. Dislikes peas. Budget cheap-to-mid. Want lunch+dinner plans that branch out with twists — not the same four hits on loop — while staying familiar enough to cook.
